items.title: OpenAI’s new AI smart speaker will reportedly sell for between $300 and $400
items.summary: Additional details about OpenAI's mysterious new AI device make it sound like a pricey smart speaker.
items.author: Lucas Ropek

items.title: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
items.summary: OpenAI said that ChatGPT free and Go users are also getting a new think button for complex queries.
items.author: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company
items.summary: Taking vibe-coding a step further, Naïve claims its infra can automate most of the work in setting up and running a business.
items.author: Ram Iyer

items.title: Gen Z dating apps like Ditto ditch swiping in favor of AI matchmaking
items.summary: This generation of twentysomethings is so disillusioned with swipe-based dating apps that they'll try literally anything else — even an AI matchmaker.
items.author: Amanda Silberling

items.title: OpenAI says Apple’s own security practices undermine its trade secrets case
items.summary: Newly filed court exhibits show OpenAI’s legal strategy in Apple’s trade secrets lawsuit: argue that Apple’s own security and offboarding practices — including allowing an Apple manager to access a former engineer’s iCloud account after he left the company —undermine its claims that the allegedly stolen information was properly protected.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: Amid legal battles, Suno says it will start watermarking songs
items.summary: Suno's watermarking feature comes as the company is fighting legal battles on several fronts.
items.author: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Ex-Spotify employees raise $10M to bring the AI behind its recommendations to e-commerce
items.summary: The startup's platform predicts which product a shopper wants next, learns their general taste, and fine-tunes continuously based on what they do in real time.
items.author: Lauren Forristal

items.title: Exclusive: Mirendil inks $100M+ Google Cloud deal to scale self-improving AI
items.summary: Mirendil has signed a $100 million-plus Google Cloud partnership to expand its compute infrastructure, powering research into self-improving AI systems designed to accelerate scientific discovery and AI development.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: Google Maps adds agentic features, including food ordering and hotel bookings
items.summary: The launch of these new features reflects Google’s ambitions to transform Google Maps from a navigation tool into an assistant that's capable of helping users complete real-world tasks.
items.author: Aisha Malik

items.title: Omilia raises $67M to scale its customer support platform
items.summary: The Series B is the company's second fundraise since it last raised capital in 2020. In that time, it has increased its ARR by 10x to $60 million.
items.author: Ivan Mehta
